title: A global affine open meeting every fibre of a smooth connected group over a normal affine integral base
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral affine Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], where normal means every local ring is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $p:H\to S$ be a smooth separated morphism of finite presentation [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]; separated means that the diagonal is a closed immersion. Suppose $H$ is an $S$-group scheme: it has multiplication $H\times_SH\to H$, inverse $H\to H$, and unit $e:S\to H$ satisfying the group identities [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose every fibre $H_s=H\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is geometrically connected, meaning connected after every residue-field extension [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-residue-field]. Then there is a single affine open subscheme $V\subseteq H$ [def-weil-open-immersion] such that $V_s\ne\varnothing$ for every $s\in S$, equivalently the restriction $p|_V:V\to S$ is surjective on points [def-weil-surjective-morphism]. The whole given $S$ is retained, and $H$ need not be commutative, proper, or affine.
